digest.component_or_area: Git fetch coordination and sync reconciliation
propositions: Parallel ref-updating Git fetches against a shared common directory race without coordination, causing compare-and-swap mismatch failures on remote-tracking refs

The sync fetch path (rebar._store.sync.reconverge) and snapshot fetch path (rebar._snapshot.git_fetch.fetch_origin) each apply operation-specific locks but do not coordinate with each other, leaving remote-tracking refs unprotected
Linked Git worktrees and symlinked clones share one Git common directory, enabling concurrent operations to update the same remote-tracking ref without serialization
Controlled experiments with parallel execution against fresh local repositories reproduce the stale-reference failure consistently, while serialized execution produces zero failures
The existing per-worktree advisory Git lock is keyed on the per-worktree git directory and explicitly excludes fetch legs, leaving the shared common-directory refs uncoordinated
